E. W. Hornung, The Amateur Cracksman.
Standard Ebooks edition: https://standardebooks.org/ebooks/e-w-hornung/the-amateur-cracksman

People whose words are in the text, and their death years:
- E. W. Hornung, the author, died 1921.

First publication of the text used: 1899 (SE colophon: 'The Amateur Cracksman was published in 1899 by E. W. Hornung.')

Why this is public domain:
- United States: the text was first published in 1899, before 1931, so it is in the public domain in the United States.
- Country of origin: the facts do not name the country of first publication. Every person whose words are in the text died in 1925 or earlier (the last to die died in 1921), so the text is public domain in every country with a term of life + 100 years or less.
